title: BNSS is a new procedure Code (Act 46 of 2023), in force 1 July 2024

content.overview: BNSS is a new procedure Code (Act 46 of 2023), in force 1 July 2024. CrPC is historical concordance only. Never assume CrPC X = BNSS Y. Headline maps: 154→173, 41→35, 167→187, 190→210, 438→482, 439→483, 482→528.
